spans.s:
‘ekanāthamukhabhañjana’
by Viśvarūpa Gaṇaka alias Munīśvara (born 1603 A. D.), son of Raṅganātha Gaṇaka; descriptive name of a.'s C. Vivaraṇa on Bhāskara's Krāntipātāryātraya. Alwar 1735.
. Conjectural title of Kuvalayānandakhaṇḍana or Alaṅkārasārasthiti of Bhīmasena Dīkṣita. See Alaṅkārasārasthiti, NCC. I. p. 299a.

‘ekākṣaranighaṇṭu’
by a disciple of Rāmabhadramakhin with a.. C.
. It is doubtful if this is a. Ekākṣara lex.

‘ekākṣarapraśastabuddhoṣṇīṣasūtra’
Bud. Nanjio 1023. See Uṣṇīṣacakravarttitantra. NCC. II. p. 402b.

‘ekākṣaroṣṇīṣacakrarājādhyāyakalpa’
Bud. Nanjio 1023 (in App.). See NCC. II. p. 402b.

‘ekāmreśvaradevālayaśāsanāni’
Inscriptions from temples of Ekāmreśvara, Varadarāja etc. a. Kāñcīpura an. other temples like Tirukkalukkunram.
. by Devīdatta Śāstrin. Ujjain Latest Additions 26.
